title: harmmean
summary: Compute the harmonic mean of numeric data.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider reduction hooks exist.

description: `harmmean(X)` computes the harmonic mean along the first non-singleton dimension. Dimension, vector-dimension, `"all"`, `"includenan"`, and `"omitnan"` forms are supported.
behaviors: `"omitnan"` skips NaNs in each slice; empty slices return `NaN`.
A zero in a slice produces a zero harmonic mean for that slice.
Numeric and logical inputs are promoted to double precision.

faqs.question: Can I reduce over several dimensions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pass a dimension vector such as `harmmean(X,[1 3])`.
